title: Hasna Cabral’s daughter Basha asks public to stop making AI images of late mom

blocks.text: Basha, the daughter of former “Pinoy Big Brother: Otso” housemate Hasna Cabral, has appealed to social media users to stop creating AI-generated images featuring her late mother, saying the content makes her deeply uncomfortable. In a Facebook post on Wednesday, Nov. 25, Basha asked those who had created AI-generated thumbnails of the actress to remove them out of respect for their family. “Hey daughter of Hasna Cabral here. I do not like when people make AI thumbnails of my mom who passed away. I’m very DEEPLY uncomfortable,” she wrote. “Respectfully, if you’re one of these people who made AI thumbnails of […]...
